# Evidence status

> Complete full-source and scale evidence is selected by the separate `CURRENT`
> pointers under `tests/bench/results/benchmark/`. Interpret only one immutable
> run at a time.

# Research question

On complete million-scale public scRNA-seq matrices, how do CerebroNexus's `bpcells` and `h5` backends trade construction time, stored size, process memory, hydrated startup, and expression access after the PR0-PR6 performance work?

This is an engineering benchmark, not a comparison of biological methods. It does not claim controlled cold-disk behaviour, statistical significance, or cross-machine generality.

# Sources and backends

| source | complete cells | genes | compared backends |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 10x mouse brain E18 | 1,306,127 | 27,998 | bpcells, h5 |
| PsychAD HBCC human PFC | 1,486,324 | 34,176 | bpcells, h5 |

Every acquired file must match its pinned byte size and SHA-256 value. No source is truncated to 50k, 150k, or one million cells. `embedded` is labelled not representable because both complete matrices exceed `Matrix::dgCMatrix`'s 32-bit non-zero index limit.

# Measurement design

Each source/backend pair has five independent build processes. Each build is
opened by two independent access processes, producing 20 builds and 40 access
rows in the full-source profile.

The artifact path uses the production defaults under test: gene-major BPCells storage, H5 group `expression`, `saveCerebro()` with qs2, and public `readCerebro()` hydration. Build timing separately records source opening, backend writing, shell construction, and CRB serialization.

A deterministic 12-gene query plan is frozen before timed builds. Access processes measure full-cell row and block reads plus a reverse-ordered, non-contiguous workload over up to 100,000 cells. Full and subset values must match source fingerprints.

# Evidence gate

The wrapper requires a clean Git state, explicit storage description, fixed thread count, verified source cache, complete schedules, matching query-plan and value fingerprints, and generated report outputs. Only a fully validated run is published:

```text
tests/bench/results/benchmark/full/
├── CURRENT
└── runs/<run-id>/
    ├── 05_schedule.csv
    ├── 10_export.csv
    ├── 20_access.csv
    ├── query_plan_manifest.csv
    ├── query_panel.csv
    ├── run_manifest.csv
    ├── source_manifest.csv
    ├── summary.md
    └── figures/expression_backend_benchmark_overview.png
```

# Reproduction

Run from a clean checkout in the pinned environment on an exclusive node with local scratch storage:

```bash
BENCH_THREADS=1 \
  BENCH_SOURCE_CACHE=/persistent/cache \
  BENCH_SCRATCH_PARENT=/local/scratch \
  BENCH_STORAGE_DESCRIPTION="local NVMe; ext4; model=<model>" \
  tests/bench/benchmark/run.sh
```

Read the selected immutable run's generated `summary.md`, raw CSV rows, and
figure together. The full protocol and interpretation limits are documented in
`tests/bench/docs/methodology.md`.
